verdict.rationale: The evidence shows only goal-style single prompts (`runs.create("Find the top Hacker News story")`) and sessions that can hold several runs, plus a Python library for calling the agent from your own code. These are developer building blocks: a user could script loops and conditionals around them, but the product documents no workflow composition feature with loops, conditionals or parameters of its own. Under the partial-credit rules, that leaves the verdict at none.
